name: Neutral Good
desc: Neutral good (NG) folk do the best they can to help others according to their needs. Many celestials, some cloud giants, and most gnomes are neutral good.
content: Neutral Good (NG) is an alignment where individuals strive to aid others to the best of their ability based on their needs. This alignment is often associated with celestials, cloud giants, and gnomes.

name: Lawful Neutral
desc: Lawful neutral (LN) individuals act in accordance with law, tradition, or personal codes. Many monks and some wizards are lawful neutral.
content: Lawful Neutral (LN) individuals adhere to law, tradition, or personal codes. This alignment is common among monks and some wizards, who prioritize order and balance in their actions. Lawful neutral characters are known for their strict adherence to rules and principles, often seeking to maintain harmony and stability in their environments.

name: Neutral
desc: Neutral (N) is the alignment of those who prefer to steer clear of moral questions and don't take sides, doing what seems best at the time. Lizardfolk, most druids, and many humans are neutral.
content: Neutral (N) is the alignment of those who prefer to steer clear of moral questions and don't take sides, doing what seems best at the time. This alignment is embodied by Lizardfolk, most druids, and many humans.

name: Chaotic Neutral
desc: Chaotic neutral (CN) creatures follow their whims, holding their personal freedom above all else. Many barbarians and rogues, and some bards, are chaotic neutral.
content: Chaotic Neutral (CN) is an alignment where creatures prioritize personal freedom above all else, following their whims without strict adherence to laws or morals. Commonly embraced by barbarians, rogues, and some bards, chaotic neutral individuals are known for their unpredictable nature and independence.

name: Lawful Evil
desc: Lawful evil (LE) creatures methodically take what they want, within the limits of a code of tradition, loyalty, or order. Devils, blue dragons, and hobgoblins are lawful evil.
content: Lawful Evil (LE) creatures, such as devils, blue dragons, and hobgoblins, are known for methodically pursuing their desires within the confines of a strict code of tradition, loyalty, or order. This alignment is characterized by a calculated approach to achieving their goals, often utilizing their intelligence and cunning to manipulate situations to their advantage. The abbreviation LE stands as a symbol of their adherence to this structured and disciplined mindset, making them formidable foes to contend with in any encounter.

name: Neutral Evil
desc: Neutral evil (NE) is the alignment of those who do whatever they can get away with, without compassion or qualms. Many drow, some cloud giants, and goblins are neutral evil.
content: Neutral Evil (NE) is the alignment of those who do whatever they can get away with, without compassion or qualms. Many drow, some cloud giants, and goblins are neutral evil.

name: Chaotic Evil
desc: Chaotic evil (CE) creatures act with arbitrary violence, spurred by their greed, hatred, or bloodlust. Demons, red dragons, and orcs are chaotic evil.
content: Chaotic Evil (CE) is an alignment characterized by arbitrary violence driven by greed, hatred, or bloodlust. Creatures like demons, red dragons, and orcs typically embody chaotic evil tendencies.

name: Lawful Good
desc: Lawful good (LG) creatures can be counted on to do the right thing as expected by society. Gold dragons, paladins, and most dwarves are lawful good.
content: Lawful Good (LG) is an alignment characterized by creatures who consistently uphold moral standards and societal expectations. This alignment is exemplified by gold dragons, paladins, and many dwarves. Lawful Good individuals can be relied upon to do what is morally right, often valuing honor, integrity, and justice.

name: Chaotic Good
desc: Chaotic good (CG) creatures act as their conscience directs, with little regard for what others expect. Copper dragons, many elves, and unicorns are chaotic good.
content: Chaotic Good (CG) is an alignment where creatures act based on their conscience, disregarding societal expectations. This alignment is often associated with traits such as independence and altruism. Examples of chaotic good beings include copper dragons, elves, and unicorns.
